"""Migration of the Meridian CRM 4.2 case_lifecycle workflow."""

from typing import Any


def _field_value(record: dict[str, Any], field: str) -> Any:
    """Return a VRL field value, treating missing/null values as empty."""
    value = record.get(field, "")
    return "" if value is None else value


def _nonempty(record: dict[str, Any], field: str) -> bool:
    return _field_value(record, field) != ""


def _nvl(record: dict[str, Any], field: str, default: str) -> Any:
    value = _field_value(record, field)
    return default if value == "" else value


def fire(state: str, event: str, record: dict) -> dict:
    """Dispatch one explicit case_lifecycle event."""

    result_record = dict(record)
    matched = False
    next_state = state
    audits: list[str] = []
    notifies: list[str] = []

    # Transition order is the legacy XML document order.
    if state == "N" and event == "assign" and _nonempty(result_record, "OWNER_UID"):
        matched = True
        next_state = "A"
        audits.append("CASE_ASSIGN")

    elif state == "N" and event == "auto_escalate":
        matched = True
        next_state = "A"
        result_record["ESC_FLG"] = "Y"
        result_record["SEV_CD"] = _nvl(result_record, "SEV_CD", "3")
        audits.append("CASE_ESC")
        notifies.append("escalation")

    elif (
        state == "A"
        and event == "auto_escalate"
        and _field_value(result_record, "ESC_FLG") != "Y"
    ):
        matched = True
        next_state = "A"
        result_record["ESC_FLG"] = "Y"
        audits.append("CASE_ESC")
        notifies.append("escalation")

    elif state == "A" and event == "await_customer":
        matched = True
        next_state = "P"
        audits.append("CASE_PEND")

    elif state == "P" and event == "customer_reply":
        matched = True
        next_state = "A"

    elif (
        state == "A"
        and event == "resolve"
        and _field_value(result_record, "RES_DT") != "00000000"
    ):
        matched = True
        next_state = "R"
        audits.append("CASE_RES")

    elif state == "R" and event == "close":
        matched = True
        next_state = "X"
        audits.append("CASE_CLOSE")

    elif state == "R" and event == "reopen":
        matched = True
        next_state = "A"
        result_record["RES_DT"] = "00000000"
        audits.append("CASE_REOPEN")

    if not matched:
        audits = ["WF_NOMATCH"]

    return {
        "state": next_state,
        "record": result_record,
        "audits": audits,
        "notifies": notifies,
        "matched": matched,
    }
